chapter_title_en: Ripples Beyond the Seas—The Dry Blue Pearl
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 502 – Profound Bone's Fatal Overreach & the Dry Blue Pearl
chapter_meta_description: Han Li wins without striking a blow as Profound Bone’s greed backfires. The Dry Blue Ice Flame’s true power nearly kills him, then condenses into a legendary pearl. An arrow with a secret flees.
og_title: The Villain Destroyed Himself—Now Han Li Owns a Legendary Pearl
og_description: Profound Bone is consumed by his own borrowed power. Han Li escapes, recovers the terrifying Dry Blue Pearl, and discovers a sentient artifact playing dead.
twitter_title: Profound Bone’s greed destroyed him. Han Li walks away with a legendary ice pearl.
twitter_description: A classic Mortal Stream victory: the villain defeats himself. Plus, an arrow that was pretending to be dead suddenly flees.

lore_anchors.definition: An extremely rare and powerful Yin-aligned flame, known for its ability to instantly freeze an entire area. Its true power is suppressed when controlled by an unworthy master.
A potent, purifying flame from the Asura realm, considered even more dangerous than the Dry Blue Ice Flame. Borrowing its power without perfect control invites fatal backlash.
A rare spiritual beast specialized in devouring souls, ghosts, and Yin entities. It can inhale wandering souls from a distance and is highly effective against undead beings.
A Yang-aligned lightning technique Han Li cultivated, effective for purifying evil and restraining Yin-type powers like the Dry Blue Ice Flame.
